sources.title: Custom code-based evaluator - Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
sources.snippet: Custom code-based evaluators let you use your own AWS Lambda function to programmatically evaluate agent performance, instead of using an LLM as a judge. This gives you full control over the evaluation logic — you can implement deterministic checks, call external APIs, run regex matching, compute custom metrics, or apply any business-specific rules.
